reader.zh-Hant: WebTopologySpiderTool 會優先嘗試使用網站 sitemap（含 robots.txt 宣告），若不可用才回退到同網域 BFS 探索，並回傳拓樸樹與子頁估算。
reader.en: WebTopologySpiderTool prioritizes website sitemaps (including robots.txt declarations) and falls back to same-domain BFS when sitemap is unavailable.
reader.ja: WebTopologySpiderTool は sitemap（robots.txt の宣言含む）を優先使用し、利用不可時のみ同一ドメイン BFS にフォールバックします。

examples.title: Map site topology from a seed URL

runtime_notes.content: Traversal depth is capped and page count is bounded to avoid runaway crawling.
Tool first discovers sitemap URLs from /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, and robots.txt. If sitemap URLs are found, source_mode becomes sitemap and BFS is skipped.
Only links within the same netloc are included in traversal and topology.
Tool emits incremental debug progress events and supports max_runtime_seconds to avoid long blocking runs.
Supports save_policy/output_target/output_path so large topology outputs can be persisted to file instead of inline history.
